audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty framing (even early, Maokai favored mid, Zilean favored late) already matches the kit: Twisted Advance is a point-and-click root with no counterplay besides spacing, and Zilean has no way to answer it until Chronoshift.
audit.why: Twisted Advance (W) is a dash-root with no skillshot to dodge; only its 14/13/12/11/10s cooldown gives Zilean a window.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit anywhere, only 'count its cooldown' with no actual number.
audit.why: Twisted Advance is 14s at rank 1 (down to 10s at rank 5); Zilean's E is a flat 15s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Twisted Advance makes Maokai briefly untargetable (so burst thrown into the dash is wasted), that Sap Magic sustain needs Grievous Wounds timing, or that Nature's Grasp is terrain that can wall off a retreat.
audit.why: All three are flagged in missingInteractions as applicable and absent from current text.
audit.corrected: Added the untargetable-dash point to dosFull[0], the terrain/Flash point to a new report note, and antiheal timing to report[8] (itemization).

edits.before: Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: He's untargetable mid-dash on Twisted Advance — don't dump E or Q into the animation, wait for the root to land or whiff first.

edits.before: Q the carry, W, Q the stun, walk — the double-bomb chunk that started as chip.
edits.after: Bomb the sapling spot before he plants it — a landed Time Bomb denies the zone Sapling Toss needs to matter.

edits.before: Spending the R on a survivable catch — the undo insures deaths, not discomfort.
edits.after: A caught carry who's still fightable doesn't need the revive — bank it for the hit that would actually kill.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root): matchup-defining — Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. It writes your spacing rules. - E Time Warp is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Twisted Advance (Root) is 14s at rank 1, down to 10s at rank 5 — count it before stepping up. - Your 15s E Time Warp is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Helia or Mandate, Swiftness, Redemption paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Helia or Mandate, Swiftness, Redemption paths. Sap Magic heals him on every auto and spell hit, so buy anti-heal before it swings extended trades.

edits.before: Track Maokai’s Twisted Advance (Root): Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Twisted Advance: point-and-click root, count the cooldown. Nature's Grasp is terrain that can wall off your retreat — hold Flash for the wall, not for damage.
